content.short: Unleash the Otherworldly Wonders - Own Your Piece of the Universe with Intergalactic Beastiary NFTs
content.description:
The Intergalactic Passes are a set of three galactic passes that are part of the Intergalactic Beastiary project with a total supply of 300.

Passes are categorized into three rarities, similar to previous Time Shifter Passes. To make trading of the passes more engaging, we have introduced a new feature. The pass type that experiences the highest trading volume during the two weeks after its launch will receive a 100% royalty from aftermarket sales, which will be distributed among pass holders. After the two-week contest, the winning pass will retain its status of receiving 100% royalties from aftermarket sales. Additionally, those who possess all three types of passes will receive extra perks.

Holders with "Interstellar Tyrant" PASS will be able to mint 5 Intergalactic Beastiary NFTs and receive an exclusive Intergalactic Beastiary Realm NFT airdrop.

Holders with "Galactic Adventurer" PASS will have the opportunity to mint 4 NFTs and receive the same airdrop, while holders with "Galactic Defender" PASS will be able to mint 3 NFTs and receive the airdrop as well.

Overall, the Intergalactic Passes offer a unique opportunity to participate in the Intergalactic Beastiary project and potentially win rewards for being a top performer in the "Battle for Intergalactic Treasury" game.

In addition to the benefits outlined above, all Intergalactic Passes will also grant access to an exclusive membership that will offer additional perks. The specific details of these perks will be decided based on suggestions from pass holders, providing an opportunity for the community to have a say in the development of the project. This membership will further enhance the value of the Intergalactic Passes and provide an ongoing incentive for holders to participate in the project.
